_upstream.body_excerpt:
Report HTTP MCP startup problems clearly in codex exec

## Why

Low-level transport errors can clutter stderr and include endpoint
URLs with credentials. An optional HTTP MCP server can also still be
starting when its tools are omitted from a turn.

## What changed

- Warn once per Streamable HTTP connection when startup fails or the
  server is omitted from the turn because startup is still pending.
  Include the server name and a short reason without the raw transport
  error.
- Filter redundant MCP worker errors from default `codex exec` stderr
  and preserve caller control through `RUST_LOG`.
- Add server context to errors when startup blocks a tool call or
  resource operation, when a tool call finds a disconnected server,
  or when HTTP session recovery fails.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for startup warnings, credential omission,
explicit `RUST_LOG` diagnostics, and an optional server that becomes
ready in time to be included in the turn.
